name: Run on Lava for Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Run on Lava for Brainrots! 🔥

Grab Brainrots straight from the burning lava! 🌋
The lava damages you — stay longer by upgrading your HP! ❤️‍🔥
Increase your speed to run across the lava faster! 🏃💨
Upgrade Brainrots to boost your income! 💸
Rebirth to gain more money! 🔁

Support the game with a Like and join the group for even more awesome updates! 👍
